name: Clawifi
description: Clawifi web search provider for OpenClaw. Works without an API key; a free key adds filters and more results.

webSearch.apiKey.label: Clawifi API Key (optional)
webSearch.apiKey.help: Optional. Search works without a key (12 calls a minute, 50 a day, 3 results). A key (or the CLAWIFI_API_KEY env var) adds filters and up to 10 results at 1 credit a search. Free account: https://clawifi.dev/?utm_source=openclaw&utm_medium=integration&utm_campaign=clawhub-plugin
